comparison.input_identity_limitation: NCU workers record output hashes and fixed source/case/seed, but no independent input hash. Standalone performance fixture input hashes are preserved separately.

matched_ncu.scope: One application-replay capture for each route, same study.py worker/case/seed and profiler protocol; supports traffic mechanism, not standalone timing or whole-model traffic claims.

lifetime_diagnostic_followup.scope: Diagnostic only; no latency or promotion claim

release_regression.source_identity_note: Test source hash captured at evidence assembly after successful run; raw unittest log does not itself embed source hashes. Measured implementation dependency hashes match the report identities recorded above.

dispatch_constraints: Exact Converse2D class and saved default bound forward; variant v7; effective backend auto or cuda.
Finite eps >= 1e-5; circular padding is a positive integer no larger than either input spatial dimension.
Nonempty contiguous strided CUDA FP16 NCHW without lazy conjugate/negative flags; compatible FP32 parameters on the same device.
Input/output indexing fits INT32; valid kernel/broadcast dimensions.
No CUDA autocast or TF32; no differentiable input under enabled GradMode. Frozen GradMode remains enabled.
Supported but ineligible inputs use saved_original(xlow.float()); unsupported activation dtype and non-FP32 parameters are rejected.
